welcome.html:
Hello! I am your shop's live {{ provider }} AI advisor. 🚀

All your orders, profitability breakdowns, and the live USD exchange rate (1$ = {{ rate }} ₺) from the VDS financial engine are loaded into my memory in the background.

How can I help you today?
• 📸 Image Analysis: Paste (Ctrl+V) or upload a product photo to check if it will sell on Etsy and at what price.
• 📊 Excel & PDF Audit: Upload a shipping invoice, cost sheet, or order report to start an analysis.
• 💰 Finance & Net Profit: We can review your shop's profitability breakdown and missing costs.
